pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Cheating in exams

2. Which response best shows understanding of Hajj and Umrah? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hajj and Umrah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hajj and Umrah.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hajj and Umrah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Hajj and Umrah has no place in daily life.

3. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Waste food daily

4. Which response best shows understanding of Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in revealed scriptures? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Belief in revealed scriptures with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Belief in revealed scriptures to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Belief in revealed scriptures has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in revealed scriptures.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions ? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions .
   B. Use Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions  to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions  has no place in daily life.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Selected verses? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Selected verses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Selected verses to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected verses.
   D. Say Selected verses has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Ulul-Azm Prophets? (1 mark)
   A. Use Ulul-Azm Prophets to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulul-Azm Prophets.
   C. Say Ulul-Azm Prophets has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Ulul-Azm Prophets with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Ulum al- Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Use Ulum al- Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Ulum al- Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Ulum al- Hadith has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulum al- Hadith.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Commanding good and forbidding evil? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Commanding good and forbidding evil with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Commanding good and forbidding evil to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Commanding good and forbidding evil has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Commanding good and forbidding evil.

11. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

12. Which response best shows understanding of Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Say Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah.
   D. Use Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain The Rightly Guided Caliphs 16 Total Number of Lessons 120 Note: The suggested nu and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain The Rightly Guided Caliphs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Modes of preservation of the Qur’an and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. A — Telling the truth and keeping trust

2. C — Apply the teaching of Hajj and Umrah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. C — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

4. A — Apply the teaching of Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. A — Apply the teaching of Belief in revealed scriptures with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. C — Apply the teaching of Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. A — Apply the teaching of Selected verses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. D — Apply the teaching of Ulul-Azm Prophets with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. B — Apply the teaching of Ulum al- Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. A — Apply the teaching of Commanding good and forbidding evil with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. C — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

12. B — Apply the teaching of Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of The Rightly Guided Caliphs 16 Total Number of Lessons 120 Note: The suggested nu; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of The Rightly Guided Caliphs; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Modes of preservation of the Qur’an; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
